QuestInfo.name: Strange Puppet
QuestInfo.1:
#p1012111# says the other towns need to know about the weird stuff happening in #m100000000#. He wants you to collect some evidence and take it to #b#p1040000##k in #b#m104020000##k.

Hunt #b50 #o9101054#s#k of any kind and collect #t4034065# to bring to #p1040000#.

#questorder1##i4034073:# #t4034073:# #c4034073#/1
#questorder1##o9101054# #a225241#
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Chief Stan's warning to #p1040000# and gave him the Golem Doll. He doesn't like the look of this one bit.

0.0: There've been strange things happening near #m100000000#. I agree with the Chief's idea, for once.
0.1: It would take too long to hit all the towns, so let's tell #b#p1040000##k, the guard in #b#m104020000##k. He'll spread the word.\r\nBut you'll need solid evidence to convince him.
0.2: Hunt #b50 #o9101054#s#k and collect the #b#t4034073##k that they drop. Bring it to #p1040000#. Is that doable?

yes.0: Great. I bet that Golem Doll won't drop easily, so be persistent!

no.0: It's not? I heard you defeated #o9101054# and saved #p1012108#... Were you just making up stories?

1.0: Zzz...\r\nHuh? W-who's there! Oh, it's just you. You startled me, Evan. Chief Stan and #p1012111# sent you? Something happen in #m100000000#?

yes.0: This doll made the monsters change? Unbelievable... But I don't think Bruce would lie about something like this. Well, I got it. I'll relay the message to other towns.

npc.0: Did you forget your mission? Hunt #b50 #o9101054#s#k and find the #b#t4034073##k to bring to #b#p1040000##k.

item.0: Oh, it's just you. You startled me, Evan. Something going on in #m100000000#? I've heard talk of puppets and other weirdness, but that's just crazy talk. I'm going to need some #bevidence#k to believe that.
